name: Cosmic Run
detailed_description:
In a galaxy ruled by the oppressive Unified Order and controlled by the Ministry of Prosperity, the Zogark family dares to defy the system. Now fugitives on the run, they must use their unique skills and ship upgrades to outwit and outrun the relentless Galactic Fleet, fighting for survival and a future where freedom thrives.

  • 150+ UPGRADES

  • SHORT & INTENSE SESSIONS

  • 15 PERMANENT UPGRADES

AND MORE...

DYNAMIC SHIP CUSTOMIZATION

Build your ship differently in every run. Choose from a wide variety of 12 Weapons, and 12 Gear Modules to suit your playstyle and adapt to ever-changing threats.

DISTINCT PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

Pick from multiple members of the Zogark family, each with unique strengths, weaknesses, and special abilities. Find the character that best fits your strategy—or master them all.

INTEGRATED DIALOGUE SYSTEM

Stay immersed in the action with a non-intrusive, real-time dialogue system. Characters speak dynamically during gameplay—offering insights, tips, and story moments without breaking the flow.

PROCEDURALLY GENERATED UPGRADES

No two runs are the same. Encounter randomized upgrade options throughout your journey, forcing you to adapt your tactics and experiment with powerful new builds each time.

PERSISTENT PROGRESSION

Earn credits during your missions to unlock and upgrade permanent perks. Even when a run ends, your hard-earned progress carries over—making you stronger with every attempt.

short_description: Cosmic Run is a single player space roguelite game. Take on hordes of galactial enemies, build your ship strategically to overcome the hurdles, improve your stats to stand longer and flee the Zogark family from the galaxy. Fight, Build, Survive, Escape!
supported_languages:
English*, German*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best on systems with 2+ physical cores. No dedicated GPU required.
